title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.21056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent self-improving coding agents have achieved strong benchmark performance by iteratively modifying their own executable implementations. A common pattern uses downstream task-derived evidence to decide which candidates or lineages continue evolving, which we term evaluate-and-select. Obtaining this signal requires repeatedly executing evolved agents on downstream tasks, so broader exploration incurs increasing evaluation cost, while repeated optimization against a fixed evaluation distribution may encourage benchmark-specific adaptation. We ask: can coding agents self-improve without downstream task evaluation inside the evolution loop? We introduce Explore-then-Integrate (ELITE), which integrates implementation mechanisms rather than selecting a single exploratory child to continue the lineage. translated_title: 面向编程智能体的免评估递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 最近的自我改进型编程智能体通过迭代修改自身可执行的实现代码，取得了强劲的基准测试表现。一种常见模式是利用源自下游任务的证据来决定哪些候选者或谱系得以继续演化，我们将其称为“评估-选择”。获取这种信号需要在下游任务上反复执行演化后的智能体，因此更广泛的探索会带来不断攀升的评估成本，而针对固定评估分布的反复优化则可能诱发针对基准的特定性适应。我们提出这样的问题：编程智能体能否在演化循环内部不进行下游任务评估的情况下实现自我改进？我们提出了“先探索后整合”方法，它通过整合多种实现机制来推进演化，而不是选择单一的探索性子代来延续谱系。在每一代中，ELITE提出多样化的聚焦式改进，从同一父代出发独立实现这些改进，并检查其结果……
tldr: 该论文提出ELITE方法，使编程智能体无需在演化循环中进行下游任务评估即可实现递归自我改进，通过整合多个改进实现而非选择单一子代，从而降低评估成本并避免针对基准的特定性适应。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ELITE, a method enabling coding agents to recursively self-improve without downstream task evaluation inside the evolution loop, by integrating multiple improvement implementations rather than selecting a single child, thereby reducing evaluation costs and avoiding benchmark-specific adaptation.
